doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Closing and Pluto Return pointer
summary: Rowe thanks him, Bergonzi urges him to look up Pluto Return, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’ve absolutely enjoyed this conversation and I’m going to have that Pluto thing on my mind.

Just check it out. Pluto — first just go Pluto Return. Then Pluto Return USA. Nobody ever has a Pluto Return in their own chart. You don’t live 248 years. But countries have Pluto Returns. So check it out. It’s heavy.
All right. Well you’re a heavy musician and thank you for sharing what you did today.
Thank you so much, Monk. Appreciate it.
All right. I’ll pause us and then we’ll say our good-byes.
